=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:402-415 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `is_draft` is referenced in the auto-merge failure rollback path without being initialized on the new-PR path, and the rollback condition also demotes already-ready PRs to draft.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers identified the same unbound-variable root cause at the same line, and several also noted the broader behavioral regression; severity was highest as critical from one reviewer and confidence is maxed.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:228-233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Critical git `ls-remote` and `fetch` operations now suppress failures with `check=False`, so downstream checkout errors hide the real root cause.
  WHY: All reviewers described the same silent-failure issue on the same contiguous lines; severity is the highest stated among reviewers, and confidence is the highest stated.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:296-298 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The refresh branch push now uses `--force-with-lease`, which introduces a concurrency/race concern if the branch changes between fetch and push.
  WHY: Two reviewers raised the same race-related concern on the push step; one reviewer explicitly treated it as low severity, and the other as low concern.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:333-336, 402, 415 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `is_draft` variable is only initialized inside the `if existing_prs:` block but is referenced in the `undo_ready` logic at line 402 (`undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)`).
  WHY: Python will raise `UnboundLocalError: local variable 'is_draft' referenced before assignment` when the code tries to evaluate `(not is_draft)` in the new PR creation path after auto-merge failure.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:228, 231, 233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Git operations (`ls-remote`, `fetch`) changed from `check=True` to `check=False`, suppressing failures.
  WHY: Network or remote-ref issues will be silently ignored, making later checkout errors harder to diagnose.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:296 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unconditional `git push --force-with-lease` on the refresh branch could overwrite concurrent remote work if another runner or human updates the branch between fetch and push.
  WHY: Race condition where two validation refresh runs or a manual hotfix could cause one run's work to overwrite another's, leading to lost changes.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)` logic change means ANY ready PR that fails auto-merge gets demoted to draft, not just new PRs or previously draft PRs.
  WHY: A PR intentionally marked ready by a human that fails auto-merge (e.g., due to branch protection rules) will be unexpectedly demoted to draft, disrupting workflow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:402, 415 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The variable `is_draft` is referenced in the `except CommandFailure` block for auto-merge, but is only defined in the `if existing_prs:` branch.
  WHY: If `created_new_pr` is True, `is_draft` is never initialized; when `executor.run(["gh", "pr", "merge", ...])` fails, the `except` block evaluates `undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)`, which will raise `UnboundLocalError: local variable 'is_draft' referenced before assignment`.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:225-233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `_checkout_refresh_branch` method uses `check=False` for critical git operations (`ls-remote` and `fetch`), but assumes they succeeded in subsequent logic.
  WHY: If the `git fetch` for the `default_branch` or the `branch_name` fails (e.g., due to network issues or permission errors), the subsequent `git checkout -B` will attempt to use a potentially stale or non-existent `start_ref`.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Logic for `undo_ready` incorrectly demotes existing ready-to-review PRs to draft on auto-merge failure.
  WHY: The expression `undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)` evaluates to True if `is_draft` is False, so a PR intentionally marked ready for review will be demoted to draft unexpectedly.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:298 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Use of `git push --force-with-lease` without a fresh fetch immediately preceding the push.
  WHY: If another process or a human pushes to the remote refresh branch between the start of the job and the final push, `--force-with-lease` will fail and stop the automation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The variable `is_draft` is only assigned inside the `if existing_prs:` block but is referenced in the auto-merge failure exception handler.
  WHY: When a new PR is created, `is_draft` is never defined; evaluating `undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)` raises `UnboundLocalError`.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:228-233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Three git operations changed from `check=True` to `check=False`, hiding failures.
  WHY: If network connectivity fails or the remote branch does not exist, the commands now return success with empty output and the code continues until a later checkout failure masks the root cause.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:296 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Changed from `git push --set-upstream` to `git push --force-with-lease --set-upstream`.
  WHY: This can still race with another runner or a manual push; the lease prevents some overwrites but a concurrent update can still cause the push to fail or conflict.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rollback condition broadens from draft/new PRs to any non-draft PR.
  WHY: `undo_ready = created_new_pr or existing_was_draft or (not is_draft)` will demote ready PRs to draft on auto-merge failure, changing prior behavior and surprising users.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `is_draft` is assigned only inside the `if existing_prs:` block but is referenced in the auto-merge failure `except` block.
  WHY: A new PR path leaves `is_draft` unbound, so `not is_draft` can raise `UnboundLocalError` and the rollback expression is also semantically broken.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:228, 231, 233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `check=False` on `git ls-remote` and `git fetch` suppresses failures.
  WHY: Network/auth failures are now silently ignored, and the later checkout fails with a misleading error instead of the actual fetch problem.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rollback condition now demotes any non-draft PR on auto-merge failure.
  WHY: Previously only new PRs or PRs that started as draft would be reverted; now ready-for-review PRs get forced back to draft, disrupting reviewers.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:415 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `undo_ready` expression references `is_draft` without initialization on the new-PR path and broadens rollback semantics to all ready PRs.
  WHY: A new PR auto-merge failure can trigger `UnboundLocalError`, and the condition also demotes any non-draft PR to draft unexpectedly.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:228, 231, 233 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote` and `git fetch` use `check=False`, suppressing command failures.
  WHY: Silent fetch failure pushes the error to later checkout logic, obscuring the real root cause of network or remote-ref problems.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
